Components.Name: GameHud
Components.Description: The frame of a game screen: the scene (the default slot: a canvas, a picture) and the HUD over it, in nine areas named by slots: top-start, top, top-end, start, center, end, bottom-start, bottom, bottom-end.

Props.Name: Padding
Props.Description: The distance of the areas from the edges, in pixels.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: The name of the screen for screen readers.

Components.Name: GameBar
Components.Description: A bar of a game: health, mana, experience, stamina or any other amount.

Props.Name: Value
Props.Description: The amount.

Props.Name: Max
Props.Description: The most it holds.

Props.Name: Kind
Props.Description: health, mana, experience, stamina or a name of its own (its color: --elemenx-game-<Kind>).

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: The name shown with the bar.

Props.Name: ShowValue
Props.Description: Shows the value on the bar.

Props.Name: Segments
Props.Description: Draws the bar in so many parts (0: one).

Props.Name: Size
Props.Description: small, medium or large.

Props.Name: Color
Props.Description: A color of its own.

Components.Name: GameItemCard
Components.Description: The card of an item of a game: its Name in the color of its Rarity, its Rarity and Type, its Stats [{Label, Value}] and its Description, on the panel of the theme.

Props.Name: Item
Props.Description: The item: {Name, Rarity, Type, Stats, Description}.

Props.Name: Place
Props.Description: A style that places the card: fixed, it floats over the page; none, it is in the flow.

Components.Name: GameSlot
Components.Description: A slot of an action bar (hotbar): a button with an Icon or an Image, a Label for the hint and screen readers, Count and Rarity (common, uncommon, rare, epic, legendary).

Props.Name: Icon
Props.Description: The icon of the action.

Props.Name: Image
Props.Description: A picture in place of the icon.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: The hint, and the name for screen readers.

Props.Name: Key
Props.Description: The shortcut that presses it (1, Q).

Props.Name: Count
Props.Description: A count in the corner (0 hides it).

Props.Name: Rarity
Props.Description: common, uncommon, rare, epic or legendary: its frame and its tint.

Props.Name: Cooldown
Props.Description: The time it cools down after use, in milliseconds.

Props.Name: Active
Props.Description: Marks a toggled action.

Props.Name: Disabled
Props.Description: Turns it off: it takes no input and looks so.

Props.Name: Size
Props.Description: small, medium or large.

Props.Name: Color
Props.Description: The tint of the glass under its icon.

Props.Name: Accept
Props.Description: The types of drags it takes (['game-item']; [] takes nothing).

Props.Name: Draggable
Props.Description: Lets its content be dragged.

Props.Name: Data
Props.Description: What the slot holds: an item or a skill.

Props.Name: Group
Props.Description: The name of the bar in the places of a drag.

Props.Name: Badge
Props.Description: A mark in a corner (+5).

Props.Name: Classes
Props.Description: More classes, for a look of its own.

EventDescriptions.use: Pressed (or its key) while ready: {Label, Key}.
EventDescriptions.drop: An item was dropped on it: {Item, From, To, Current, Type}.

Components.Name: GameInventory
Components.Description: An inventory: a grid of Slots cells (Items.length by default) in Columns columns.

Props.Name: Items
Props.Description: The items by cell (null for an empty one): {ID, Name, Icon or Image, Count, Stack, Rarity...}.

Props.Name: Slots
Props.Description: How many cells (the count of Items by default).

Props.Name: Columns
Props.Description: How many cells in a row.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: The name of the grid for screen readers.

Props.Name: Name
Props.Description: The name of the inventory in the places of a drag.

EventDescriptions.use: An item was used (Enter or a double press): {Index, Item}.
EventDescriptions.move: An item moved to another cell: {From, To, Items}, the cells after the move.
EventDescriptions.receive: An item came from another inventory or slot: {Item, From, To, Current}.
EventDescriptions.give: An item was dropped on another place: {Index, Item, From, Target}.

Components.Name: GameDialogue
Components.Description: The line of a character in a dialogue: Speaker, Portrait (an image URL) and Text, typed out at Speed characters a second (0 shows it at once).

Props.Name: Speaker
Props.Description: The name of the one who speaks.

Props.Name: Portrait
Props.Description: The URL of the portrait.

Props.Name: Text
Props.Description: The line, typed out.

Props.Name: Choices
Props.Description: The answers: [{ID, Text, Disabled}].

Props.Name: Speed
Props.Description: Characters a second (0 shows the line at once).

EventDescriptions.next: The line without choices was read on (its continue button).

Components.Name: GameMenu
Components.Description: A menu of a game: the main menu, a pause menu, a list of saves.

Props.Name: Title
Props.Description: The title above the items.

Props.Name: Subtitle
Props.Description: A line under the title.

Props.Name: Items
Props.Description: The items: [{ID, Label, Hint, Icon, Disabled}].

Props.Name: AutoFocus
Props.Description: Puts the focus on the first item when it shows.

Components.Name: GameKey
Components.Description: The prompt of a control: "[A] Continue".

Props.Name: Button
Props.Description: The button of the gamepad: a, b, x, y, lb, rb, lt, rt, select, start...

Props.Name: Keyboard
Props.Description: The key of the keyboard shown without a gamepad: Enter, E, Escape.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: The text after the button.

Props.Name: Pad
Props.Description: Shows the buttons of a kind of pad whatever is plugged in: xbox, playstation, nintendo or generic.

Components.Name: GameTabs
Components.Description: The tabs of a game window: Items [{ID, Label, Disabled}] in a column (Orientation 'vertical', the default) or a row, numbered 01, 02...

Props.Name: Items
Props.Description: The tabs: [{ID, Label, Disabled}].

Props.Name: Value
Props.Description: The ID of the open tab.

Props.Name: Numbered
Props.Description: Numbers the tabs: 01, 02...

Props.Name: Orientation
Props.Description: vertical (a column) or horizontal (a row).

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: The name of the list for screen readers.

EventDescriptions.change: Another tab was opened: its ID.

Props.Name: Items
Props.Description: The quests: [{ID, Title, Group, Level, Status, Tracked, Text, Objectives, Rewards}].

Props.Name: Value
Props.Description: The ID of the open quest.

Props.Name: Variant
Props.Description: log (the journal) or tracker (the objectives of the tracked quests).

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: The name of the list for screen readers.

Props.Name: Empty
Props.Description: The text without quests.

EventDescriptions.change: Another quest was opened: its ID.
EventDescriptions.track: A quest was tracked or untracked: {ID, Tracked}.

Components.Name: GameMinimap
Components.Description: The frame of a minimap: the map in its default slot (an image, a canvas), round or square (Shape), Size pixels wide.

Props.Name: Shape
Props.Description: round or square.

Props.Name: Size
Props.Description: The width in pixels.

Props.Name: Markers
Props.Description: The marks over the map: [{ID, X, Y, Kind, Icon, Label, Color}], X and Y from 0 to 1.

Props.Name: Heading
Props.Description: The direction of the player, in degrees.

Props.Name: Player
Props.Description: Shows the arrow of the player.

Props.Name: North
Props.Description: Shows the letter N on the frame.

Props.Name: Title
Props.Description: The name of the place on the band under the map.

Props.Name: Note
Props.Description: A note on the band (coordinates, the time).

Props.Name: Zoomable
Props.Description: Adds the + and - buttons.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: The name of the map for screen readers.

EventDescriptions.marker: A marker was pressed: the marker.
EventDescriptions.zoom: A zoom button was pressed: 1 (in) or -1 (out).

Props.Name: Items
Props.Description: The players: [{ID, Name, Score, Rank, Avatar, Icon, Note, Change, Me}].

Props.Name: Limit
Props.Description: How many rows of the top show.

Props.Name: ScoreLabel
Props.Description: The name of the score.

Props.Name: Selectable
Props.Description: The rows emit select with their item.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: The name of the board for screen readers.

EventDescriptions.select: A row was pressed: its item.

Components.Name: GameCombat
Components.Description: The health of what a game of a Scene can hurt, declared inside it: damage of the hits of its weapons, deaths, bars, a host and its clients.

Props.Name: Bars
Props.Description: The bars of health over what has it: only the hurt, always or never.

Props.Name: FriendlyFire
Props.Description: A hit of a Team on its own counts.

Props.Name: Authority
Props.Description: Who applies the changes: here (local), here and sent out (host), or the host, asked (client).

Props.Name: Send
Props.Description: The transport of the application: a function given each message for the host or the clients.

EventDescriptions.damage: Something took damage: {ID, Change, Amount, Value, Max, Hit, Source}.
EventDescriptions.heal: Something was healed: {ID, Change, Amount, Value, Max, Source}.
EventDescriptions.death: Something has no health left: {ID, By, Hit}.

Components.Name: GameRace
Components.Description: A race on a closed road of a Scene, declared inside it: laps, checkpoints, times, positions, the wrong way.

Props.Name: Road
Props.Description: The ID of the road of the race; empty: the first closed road of the scene.

Props.Name: Laps
Props.Description: How many laps.

Props.Name: Racers
Props.Description: The IDs of the vehicles that race (a list, or text with commas); empty: the one under the keys.

Props.Name: Checkpoints
Props.Description: How many checkpoints a lap has, evenly round the road.

Props.Name: Countdown
Props.Description: Seconds of the countdown before the start.

Props.Name: Auto
Props.Description: Starts as the scene starts.

EventDescriptions.countdown: A second of the countdown before the start: {Seconds}.
EventDescriptions.checkpoint: A racer passed a checkpoint: {ID, Lap, Index}.
EventDescriptions.lap: A racer finished a lap: {ID, Lap, Time, Best}.
EventDescriptions.position: A racer came to another position: {ID, Position}.
EventDescriptions.wrong: A racer goes the wrong way, or the right way again: {ID, Wrong}.
EventDescriptions.finish: A racer finished: {ID, Position, Time, Best}.

Components.Name: GameStrategy
Components.Description: A strategy game on the ground of a Scene, declared inside it: selection, orders, paths round the land, attacks, the fog of war.

Props.Name: Team
Props.Description: The team of the player: its walkers are its units.

Props.Name: Fog
Props.Description: The fog of war: what the units do not see is hidden and darkened.

Props.Name: Spread
Props.Description: Metres between the units sent to one place.

Props.Name: Selected
Props.Description: The units selected from the start (IDs: a list, or text with commas), as they come.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: The name of it for screen readers.

EventDescriptions.order: Units were told to move or attack: {Kind, IDs, X, Z, Target}.
EventDescriptions.death: A unit has no health left and is gone: {ID, By}.

Services.Name: Vitals
Services.Description: The health of what a game can hurt, as data with one way in: damage and heal through rules, events, a host and its clients.

Services.Name: GameItems
Services.Description: The rules of moving the items of a game: what lies where after an item is moved onto a place.
